7 /**
8  * Resolves file path string payloads to objects containing paths and contents.
9  */
10 export function resolvePayload(payload, projectDir = null) {
11   if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
12     return payload.map(item => {
13       if (typeof item === 'string') {
14         let content = '';
15         try {
16           const fullPath = projectDir ? path.resolve(projectDir, item) : path.resolve(item);
17           content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
18         } catch {
19           // fallback
20         }
21         return { path: item, content };
22       } else if (item && typeof item === 'object' && item.content === undefined && item.path) {
23         let content = '';
24         try {
25           const fullPath = projectDir ? path.resolve(projectDir, item.path) : path.resolve(item.path);
26           content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
27         } catch {
28           // fallback
29         }
30         return { ...item, content };
31       }
32       return item;
33     });
34   }
35   return payload;
36 }

38 /**
39  * Calculates the size of a payload in bytes.
40  * Supports:
41  * - Array of objects: [ { path: 'relative/path', content: '...' }, ... ]
42  * - Array of strings: [ 'relative/path', ... ]
43  * - Object dictionary: { 'relative/path': 'content', ... }
44  */
45 export function calculatePayloadSize(payload, projectDir = null) {
46   let totalBytes = 0;
47   if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
48     for (const item of payload) {
49       if (typeof item === 'string') {
50         if (projectDir) {
51           try {
52             const fullPath = path.resolve(projectDir, item);
53             totalBytes += fs.statSync(fullPath).size;
54             continue;
55           } catch {
56             // fallback if stat fails
57           }
58         }
59         totalBytes += Buffer.byteLength(item);
60       } else if (item && typeof item === 'object') {
61         if (item.content !== undefined) {
62           totalBytes += Buffer.byteLength(item.content || '');
63         } else if (item.path) {
64           if (projectDir) {
65             try {
66               const fullPath = path.resolve(projectDir, item.path);
67               totalBytes += fs.statSync(fullPath).size;
68               continue;
69             } catch {
70               // fallback
71             }
72           }
73           totalBytes += Buffer.byteLength(item.path);
74         }
75       }
76     }
77   } else if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
78     for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(payload)) {
79       totalBytes += Buffer.byteLength(String(val || ''));
80     }
81   }
82   return totalBytes;
83 }

93 /**
94  * Normalizes path and returns the top-level directory (e.g. /backend, /frontend).
95  * Root files return '/'.
96  */
97 export function getTopLevelDir(filePath) {
98   const normalized = filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
99   const clean = normalized.startsWith('/') ? normalized.slice(1) : normalized;
100   const parts = clean.split('/');
101   if (parts.length > 1 && parts[0] !== '') {
102     return '/' + parts[0];
103   }
104   return '/';
105 }

108  * Groups files in payload by their top-level directory.

110 export function groupPayloadByTopLevelDir(payload) {
111   const groups = {};

113   if (Array.isArray(payload)) {

173 /**
174  * Estimates the serialized size in bytes without materializing the whole payload in memory.
175  */
176 export function estimateSerializedSize(payload, projectDir = null) {
177   let size = 0;
178   if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
179     for (const item of payload) {
180       if (typeof item === 'string') {
181         let fileBytes = 0;
182         try {
183           const fullPath = projectDir ? path.resolve(projectDir, item) : path.resolve(item);
184           fileBytes = fs.statSync(fullPath).size;
185         } catch {
186           // fallback
187         }
188         size += 16 + Buffer.byteLength(item) + fileBytes;
189       } else if (item && typeof item === 'object') {
190         if (item.content !== undefined) {
191           size += 16 + Buffer.byteLength(item.path || '') + Buffer.byteLength(item.content || '');
192         } else if (item.path) {
193           let fileBytes = 0;
194           try {
195             const fullPath = projectDir ? path.resolve(projectDir, item.path) : path.resolve(item.path);
196             fileBytes = fs.statSync(fullPath).size;
197           } catch {
198             // fallback
199           }
200           size += 16 + Buffer.byteLength(item.path) + fileBytes;
201         }
202       }
203     }
204   } else if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
205     for (const [filePath, content] of Object.entries(payload)) {
206       size += 16 + Buffer.byteLength(filePath) + Buffer.byteLength(String(content || ''));
207     }
208   }
209   return size;
210 }

226 // Cross-process file-lock semaphore: mkdir slot dirs under the lock dir. mkdir is
227 // atomic on every platform, so exactly one contender (handle or process) can own a
228 // slot at a time. The C4 (2026-07-11) fail-HANG mode — a crashed run's stale slot
229 // dir starving every future run forever — is closed here at the root instead of by
230 // retiring the semaphore: each slot records its owner pid, a slot whose owner is
231 // provably dead is reclaimed, and acquisition has an honest timeout (throws, never
232 // spins forever). The in-process limiter in limitConcurrency stays lock-free.
233 
234 const SLOT_POLL_MS = 25;
235 const DEFAULT_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
236 
237 function slotDirPath(lockDir, slotIndex) {
238   return path.join(lockDir, `slot-${slotIndex}`);
239 }
240 
241 function isPidAlive(pid) {
242   try {
243     process.kill(pid, 0);
244     return true;
245   } catch (err) {
246     // EPERM means the pid exists but belongs to another user — still alive.
247     return err.code === 'EPERM';
248   }
249 }
250 
251 /** Reclaims a slot whose recorded owner process is dead. Returns true if reclaimed. */
252 function reclaimIfStale(slotDir) {
253   let owner;
254   try {
255     owner = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(slotDir, 'owner.json'), 'utf8'));
256   } catch {
257     // No readable owner record — the holder may be mid-acquisition; never steal.
258     return false;
259   }
260   if (typeof owner?.pid !== 'number' || isPidAlive(owner.pid)) return false;
261   try {
262     fs.rmSync(slotDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
263     return true;
264   } catch {
265     return false;
266   }
267 }

269 export async function acquireSlot(lockDir, maxConcurrency, { timeoutMs } = {}) {
270   const slots = Math.max(1, parseInt(maxConcurrency, 10) || 1);
271   const envTimeout = parseInt(process.env.GANDALF_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS, 10);
272   const deadline = Date.now() + (timeoutMs ?? (Number.isNaN(envTimeout) ? DEFAULT_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS : envTimeout));
273   fs.mkdirSync(lockDir, { recursive: true });
274 
275   for (;;) {
276     for (let slot = 0; slot < slots; slot++) {
277       const slotDir = slotDirPath(lockDir, slot);
278       try {
279         fs.mkdirSync(slotDir);
280       } catch (err) {
281         if (err.code !== 'EEXIST') throw err;
282         reclaimIfStale(slotDir); // dead owner → freed; a live contender retries it next pass
283         continue;
284       }
285       fs.writeFileSync(path.join(slotDir, 'owner.json'), JSON.stringify({ pid: process.pid, acquired_at: new Date().toISOString() }));
286       return slot;
287     }
288     if (Date.now() >= deadline) {
289       throw new Error(`acquireSlot: timed out waiting for one of ${slots} slot(s) under ${lockDir}`);
290     }
291     await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, SLOT_POLL_MS));
292   }
293 }

295 export function releaseSlot(lockDir, slotIndex) {
296   try {
297     fs.rmSync(slotDirPath(lockDir, slotIndex), { recursive: true, force: true });
298   } catch {
299     // Releasing an already-gone slot is not an error.
300   }
301 }

303 /**
304  * Executes a list of task functions concurrently, with a maximum limit.
305  * Pure in-process semaphore: no filesystem locks, nothing to leak on a crash.
306  */
307 export async function limitConcurrency(tasks, limit) {
308   let resolvedLimit = 3;
309   if (process.env.GANDALF_MAX_CONCURRENCY) {
310     const val = parseInt(process.env.GANDALF_MAX_CONCURRENCY, 10);
311     if (!isNaN(val)) resolvedLimit = val;
312   } else if (typeof limit === 'number') {
313     resolvedLimit = limit;
314   }
315   resolvedLimit = Math.max(1, resolvedLimit);
316 
317   const results = [];
318   const executing = new Set();
319   for (const task of tasks) {
320     const p = Promise.resolve().then(() => task());
321     results.push(p);
322     executing.add(p);
323     const clean = () => executing.delete(p);
324     p.then(clean, clean);
325     if (executing.size >= resolvedLimit) {
326       await Promise.race(executing);
327     }
328   }
329   return Promise.all(results);
330 }

371 /**
372  * JUDGE-SCOPE-FIRST tier gate. Decides the cheapest tier that can honestly answer the objective
373  * over the given (already-SCOPED) payload, and DEFAULTS to 'direct'. It only escalates when the
374  * scoped artifact genuinely exceeds the limits:
375  *
376  *   • 'direct'    — the payload fits the High-Context token limit AND the per-chunk byte ceiling.
377  *                   This is the default for a small, focused question.
378  *   • 'scout'     — the payload exceeds limits and must be curated first (the safe default
379  *                   escalation). A whole-repo-sized payload on a focused question lands here and
380  *                   will NOT proceed to a Map-Reduce fan-out without an explicit opt-in.
381  *   • 'mapreduce' — only when escalation is warranted AND the operator has opted into a bulk
382  *                   fan-out (GANDALF_ALLOW_REPO_SCALE=1, or a scout bypass) so the curated
383  *                   payload may legitimately be fanned out.
384  *
385  * Pure: never spawns, never mutates. `payload` should be the scoped artifact, never the raw repo.
386  */
387 export function decideTier({
388   payload,
389   objective = '',
390   env = process.env,
391   projectDir = null,
392   highContextLimit = null,
393   maxChunkBytes = null
394 } = {}) {
395   const limit = resolveHighContextLimit(env, highContextLimit);
396   const chunkCeiling = resolveMaxChunkBytes(env, maxChunkBytes);
397 
398   const tokens = estimatePayloadTokens(payload, projectDir);
399   const bytes = estimateSerializedSize(payload, projectDir);
400 
401   // Default: a scoped payload that fits is answered directly — no scaling up.
402   if (tokens <= limit && bytes <= chunkCeiling) {
403     return 'direct';
404   }
405 
406   const wholeRepo = looksLikeWholeRepo(payload);
407   const allowRepoScale = env.GANDALF_ALLOW_REPO_SCALE === '1';
408   const skipScout = env.GANDALF_SKIP_SCOUT === 'true' || env.GANDALF_FORCE_WHOLE_REPO === 'true';
409 
410   // WHOLE-REPO GUARD: a whole-repo payload must be curated by the scout before any fan-out, and
411   // the bulk fan-out itself requires an explicit opt-in. Without it, stay at 'scout'.
412   if (wholeRepo && !allowRepoScale) {
413     return 'scout';
414   }
415 
416   // A scout bypass (or an opted-in whole-repo run) goes straight to the fan-out; otherwise the safe
417   // default is still to scout-first and curate before deciding to fan out.
418   if (skipScout) {
419     return 'mapreduce';
420   }
421   return 'scout';
422 }

424 /** Take payload items in order until the cumulative serialized size would exceed `maxChunkBytes`.
425  *  Returns the kept slice plus original/kept counts so the caller can stamp an honest degraded note. */
426 function capPayloadToBudget(payload, maxChunkBytes, projectDir) {
427   const items = getChunkItems(payload);
428   const total = items.length;
429   const kept = [];
430   let used = 0;
431   for (const item of items) {
432     const itemSize = estimateSerializedSize([item], projectDir);
433     if (kept.length > 0 && used + itemSize > maxChunkBytes) break;
434     kept.push(item);
435     used += itemSize;
436   }
437   return { kept, total, keptCount: kept.length };
438 }

627 /**
628  * INTERNAL pre-summarizer for OVERSIZED artifacts — NOT the canonical Gandalf entrypoint.
629  *
630  * The canonical, branded output is the `gandalf-advisor-1` JSON advisor envelope produced by the
631  * seam-pass host (runtime/gandalf-run.mjs → runtime/seam-pass.applySeamPass →
632  * assertIncrement1Conformant). runMapReduce returns RAW model prose; it is meant to be used only as
633  * a PRE-STAGE that pre-summarizes an artifact too large to fit a single model context, whose prose
634  * is then fed BACK as the draft into applySeamPass — never returned to the user as the report.
635  *
636  * Tiering JUDGES SCOPE FIRST via decideTier (defaults to 'direct'). If the SCOPED payload fits, it
637  * is analyzed directly. If it exceeds limits it scouts to curate first; a whole-repo-sized payload
638  * on a focused question will NOT fan out to Map-Reduce unless the operator opts in with
639  * GANDALF_ALLOW_REPO_SCALE=1. When it does fan out, it chunks by top-level directory, processes up
640  * to 3 chunks concurrently using a semaphore, and synthesizes the report. The honest degraded stamp
641  * ("analyzed slice N of M; skipped K", degraded:true) is preserved end-to-end.
642  */
643 /**
644  * Cap top-level shard groups to maxShards (band-thin LITE). Stable order; overflow
645  * merges into the last kept bucket so work is not dropped silently.
646  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} groups
647  * @param {number|null|undefined} maxShards
648  * @returns {Record<string, unknown>}
649  */
650 export function capGroupsToMaxShards(groups, maxShards) {
651   if (!groups || typeof groups !== 'object') return groups || {};
652   const entries = Object.entries(groups);
653   const n = Number(maxShards);
654   if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1 || entries.length <= n) {
655     return groups;
656   }
657   const kept = entries.slice(0, n);
658   const overflow = entries.slice(n);
659   const lastKey = kept[kept.length - 1][0];
660   let lastVal = kept[kept.length - 1][1];
661   for (const [, chunk] of overflow) {
662     if (Array.isArray(lastVal) && Array.isArray(chunk)) {
663       lastVal = lastVal.concat(chunk);
664     } else if (lastVal && typeof lastVal === 'object' && chunk && typeof chunk === 'object' && !Array.isArray(lastVal)) {
665       lastVal = { ...lastVal, ...chunk };
666     } else if (Array.isArray(lastVal)) {
667       lastVal = lastVal.concat(chunk);
668     } else {
669       lastVal = chunk;
670     }
671   }
672   kept[kept.length - 1] = [lastKey, lastVal];
673   return Object.fromEntries(kept);
674 }
675 
676 export async function runMapReduce({
677   projectDir = null,
678   payload,
679   userObjective,
680   agent = null,
681   reduceAgent = null,
682   env = process.env,
683   log = () => {},
684   highContextLimit = null,
685   concurrencyLimit = 3,
686   /** Band knobs from @foundry/triage gandalf table (optional). */
687   maxShards = null,
688   fusionPasses = null,
689 } = {}) {
690   let activeAgent = agent;
691   if (!activeAgent) {
692     // W4 (2026-07-05): resolve the agy LABEL via the TRIO_TIER ladder — NEVER a hardcoded API-style id
693     // (the old hardcoded default was a phantom id that live agy silently degrades to Flash). The clever
694     // map=STANDARD / reduce=HEAVY split is applied by the CLI wiring (runtime/gandalf-run.mjs
695     // runScaledAnalysis), which injects distinct map/reduce agents; standalone callers get one
696     // ladder-resolved agent for both roles.
697     const model = env.GANDALF_HIGH_CONTEXT_MODEL || env.GEMINI_MODEL || resolveGeminiModel({ env });
698     const seam = makeGeminiCliSeam({ model, env, log });
699     activeAgent = seam.agent;
700   }
701   // W4: the REDUCE/synthesis seat (and the single-frontier direct pass) may run on a distinct,
702   // higher-tier agent than the bulk MAP reads. Defaults to activeAgent so standalone/legacy callers
703   // (and every existing test that injects a single `agent`) behave exactly as before.
704   const activeReduceAgent = reduceAgent || activeAgent;
705 
706   // Resolve High-Context + per-chunk byte limits (shared with decideTier so they never disagree).
707   const limit = resolveHighContextLimit(env, highContextLimit);
708   const maxChunkBytes = resolveMaxChunkBytes(env);
709 
710   // Resolve Concurrency limit
711   let resolvedConcurrency = 3;
712   if (env.GANDALF_MAX_CONCURRENCY) {
713     const val = parseInt(env.GANDALF_MAX_CONCURRENCY, 10);
714     if (!isNaN(val)) resolvedConcurrency = val;
715   } else if (concurrencyLimit !== null && concurrencyLimit !== undefined) {
716     resolvedConcurrency = concurrencyLimit;
717   }
718 
719   const estimatedTokens = estimatePayloadTokens(payload, projectDir);
720   const totalSerializedSize = estimateSerializedSize(payload, projectDir);
721 
722   // JUDGE SCOPE FIRST: default to a direct pass; only escalate when the scoped artifact warrants it.
723   const tier = decideTier({ payload, objective: userObjective, env, projectDir, highContextLimit });
724 
725   if (tier === 'direct') {
726     const resolvedPayload = resolvePayload(payload, projectDir);
727     log(`Payload size (${estimatedTokens} tokens, ${totalSerializedSize} bytes) is within limits. Processing directly (tier=direct).`);
728     const directPrompt = `Analyze the following files for the objective: "${userObjective}"
729 
730 Codebase Payload:
731 ${serializeChunk(resolvedPayload, projectDir)}
732 
733 Provide a coherent advisory report addressing the user objective.`;
734 
735     // W4: a SMALL target answered in ONE frontier pass — the reduce (HEAVY/frontier) seat.
736     const report = await activeReduceAgent(directPrompt, { label: 'map-reduce-direct' });
737     return report;
738   }
739 
740   log(`Payload size (${estimatedTokens} tokens, ${totalSerializedSize} bytes) exceeds limits. Checking scout-pass default.`);
741 
742   let scoutedPayload = payload;
743   let degraded = false;
744   let stamp = '';
745 
746   const skipScout = env.GANDALF_SKIP_SCOUT === 'true' || env.GANDALF_FORCE_WHOLE_REPO === 'true';
747 
748   if (!skipScout) {
749     log(`Scouting first to filter the payload.`);
750     scoutedPayload = await scoutAndFilter({
751       projectDir,
752       payload,
753       userObjective,
754       agent: activeAgent,
755       env,
756       log
757     });
758 
759     if (isContentDropped(payload, scoutedPayload)) {
760       degraded = true;
761       const originalCount = getPayloadItemCount(payload);
762       const prunedCount = getPayloadItemCount(scoutedPayload);
763       const skippedCount = originalCount - prunedCount;
764       stamp = `analyzed slice ${prunedCount} of ${originalCount}; skipped ${skippedCount}`;
765       log(`Scouting dropped content. Stamp: "${stamp}"`);
766     }
767   } else {
768     log(`Bypassing scout pass as requested.`);
769   }
770 
771   const scoutedTokens = estimatePayloadTokens(scoutedPayload, projectDir);
772   const scoutedSerializedSize = estimateSerializedSize(scoutedPayload, projectDir);
773 
774   if (scoutedTokens <= limit && scoutedSerializedSize <= maxChunkBytes) {
775     const resolvedPayload = resolvePayload(scoutedPayload, projectDir);
776     log(`Scouted payload size (${scoutedTokens} tokens, ${scoutedSerializedSize} bytes) is within limits. Processing directly.`);
777     const directPrompt = `Analyze the following files for the objective: "${userObjective}"
778 
779 Codebase Payload:
780 ${serializeChunk(resolvedPayload, projectDir)}
781 
782 Provide a coherent advisory report addressing the user objective.`;
783 
784     // W4: the final advisory over the curated (scouted) payload — the reduce (HEAVY/frontier) seat.
785     let report = await activeReduceAgent(directPrompt, { label: 'map-reduce-direct' });
786     if (degraded) {
787       report = report + `\n\n[degraded:true] Stamp: ${stamp}`;
788       const reportStr = new String(report);
789       reportStr.degraded = true;
790       reportStr.stamp = stamp;
791       return reportStr;
792     }
793     return report;
794   }
795 
796   // WHOLE-REPO GUARD: scouting could not curate this below whole-repo scale. Do NOT silently fan out
797   // the whole repo for a focused question — that requires an explicit operator opt-in. Without it,
798   // run a bounded, honestly-degraded direct pass over the slice that fits the per-chunk ceiling.
799   const allowRepoScale = env.GANDALF_ALLOW_REPO_SCALE === '1';
800   if (looksLikeWholeRepo(scoutedPayload) && !allowRepoScale) {
801     const { kept, total, keptCount } = capPayloadToBudget(scoutedPayload, maxChunkBytes, projectDir);
802     const skippedCount = total - keptCount;
803     log(`Whole-repo guard: ${total} files exceed limits and GANDALF_ALLOW_REPO_SCALE!=1. Capping to ${keptCount} files and running a degraded direct pass instead of a Map-Reduce fan-out.`);
804     const resolvedPayload = resolvePayload(kept, projectDir);
805     const directPrompt = `Analyze the following files for the objective: "${userObjective}"
806 
807 Codebase Payload:
808 ${serializeChunk(resolvedPayload, projectDir)}
809 
810 Provide a coherent advisory report addressing the user objective.`;
811 
812     // W4: the bounded degraded pass over the fitting slice — the reduce (HEAVY/frontier) seat.
813     let report = await activeReduceAgent(directPrompt, { label: 'map-reduce-direct' });
814     // Compose an honest degraded stamp (preserving any earlier scout-drop count in the total).
815     const guardStamp = `analyzed slice ${keptCount} of ${total}; skipped ${skippedCount} (whole-repo fan-out gated; set GANDALF_ALLOW_REPO_SCALE=1 to opt in)`;
816     const finalStamp = degraded && stamp ? `${stamp}; ${guardStamp}` : guardStamp;
817     report = report + `\n\n[degraded:true] Stamp: ${finalStamp}`;
818     const reportStr = new String(report);
819     reportStr.degraded = true;
820     reportStr.stamp = finalStamp;
821     return reportStr;
822   }
823 
824   log(`Payload size (${scoutedTokens} tokens, ${scoutedSerializedSize} bytes) exceeds limits. Initiating Map-Reduce.`);
825 
826   let groups = groupPayloadByTopLevelDir(scoutedPayload);
827   // Band-thin + legacy env cap (L2/L4):
828   // - locked call sites pass maxShards = knobs.shards; GANDALF_MAX_SHARDS may only TIGHTEN
829   //   (min), never expand past the lock.
830   // - unlocked call sites leave maxShards null; GANDALF_MAX_SHARDS is the legacy-only cap.
831   let shardCap = null;
832   if (maxShards != null && Number.isFinite(Number(maxShards))) {
833     shardCap = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(maxShards)));
834     if (env.GANDALF_MAX_SHARDS) {
835       const envCap = Math.max(1, parseInt(env.GANDALF_MAX_SHARDS, 10) || 8);
836       if (Number.isFinite(envCap)) shardCap = Math.min(shardCap, envCap);
837     }
838   } else if (env.GANDALF_MAX_SHARDS) {
839     shardCap = Math.max(1, parseInt(env.GANDALF_MAX_SHARDS, 10) || 8);
840   }
841   if (shardCap != null) {
842     const before = Object.keys(groups).length;
843     groups = capGroupsToMaxShards(groups, shardCap);
844     const after = Object.keys(groups).length;
845     if (after < before) log(`band-thin: capped shards ${before} → ${after} (maxShards=${shardCap})`);
846   }
847   const groupEntries = Object.entries(groups);
848 
849   let activeCount = 0;
850   let maxActiveCount = 0;
851 
852   const tasks = groupEntries.map(([groupName, chunk]) => {
853     return async () => {
854       activeCount++;
855       if (activeCount > maxActiveCount) {
856         maxActiveCount = activeCount;
857       }
858       log(`Starting chunk analysis for ${groupName} (current active: ${activeCount}, max active: ${maxActiveCount})`);
859       
860       try {
861         const resultText = await mapOrSplit({
862           payload: chunk,
863           groupName,
864           userObjective,
865           activeAgent,
866           reduceAgent: activeReduceAgent,
867           maxChunkBytes,
868           projectDir,
869           log
870         });
871         return { group: groupName, text: resultText };
872       } finally {
873         activeCount--;
874         log(`Finished chunk analysis for ${groupName} (current active: ${activeCount})`);
875       }
876     };
877   });
878 
879   let chunkSummaries = await limitConcurrency(tasks, resolvedConcurrency);
880 
881   log(`Completed all ${chunkSummaries.length} chunk analyses (max concurrent tasks: ${maxActiveCount}). Initiating synthesis.`);
882 
883   const passes =
884     fusionPasses != null && Number.isFinite(Number(fusionPasses))
885       ? Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(fusionPasses)))
886       : 1;
887 
888   // fusionPasses > 1: hierarchical pair-fuse then final reduce (FULL band); LITE keeps one pass.
889   if (passes >= 2 && chunkSummaries.length > 2) {
890     log(`band-thin: fusionPasses=${passes} — intermediate pair fusion over ${chunkSummaries.length} shards`);
891     const mid = [];
892     for (let i = 0; i < chunkSummaries.length; i += 2) {
893       const pair = chunkSummaries.slice(i, i + 2);
894       if (pair.length === 1) {
895         mid.push(pair[0]);
896         continue;
897       }
898       const midPrompt = `You are a codebase synthesizer. Fuse these two chunk summaries.
899 User Objective: "${userObjective}"
900 
901 ${pair.map((s) => `--- Chunk: ${s.group} ---\n${s.text}`).join('\n\n')}
902 
903 Return one fused summary.`;
904       const text = await activeReduceAgent(midPrompt, { label: `map-reduce-fusion-mid-${i}` });
905       mid.push({ group: `${pair[0].group}+${pair[1].group}`, text });
906     }
907     chunkSummaries = mid;
908   }
909 
910   const synthPrompt = `You are a codebase synthesizer. You are given several chunk summaries of a codebase analysis.
911 User Objective: "${userObjective}"
912 
913 Chunk Summaries:
914 ${chunkSummaries.map(s => `--- Chunk: ${s.group} ---\n${s.text}`).join('\n\n')}
915 
916 Please fuse these summaries into a single, coherent advisory report addressing the user objective.`;
917 
918   // W4: the top-level REDUCE — fuse the shard summaries on the HEAVY/frontier seat.
919   const finalReport = await activeReduceAgent(synthPrompt, { label: 'map-reduce-synthesis' });
920   if (degraded) {
921     const reportWithStamp = finalReport + `\n\n[degraded:true] Stamp: ${stamp}`;
922     const reportStr = new String(reportWithStamp);
923     reportStr.degraded = true;
924     reportStr.stamp = stamp;
925     return reportStr;
926   }
927   return finalReport;
928 }
929 
930 function isContentDropped(original, pruned) {
931   if (!pruned || !original) return false;
932   if (Array.isArray(original) && Array.isArray(pruned)) {
933     return pruned.length < original.length;
934   }
935   if (typeof original === 'object' && typeof pruned === 'object') {
936     return Object.keys(pruned).length < Object.keys(original).length;
937   }
938   return false;
939 }
940 
941 function getPayloadItemCount(payload) {
942   if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
943     return payload.length;
944   }
945   if (payload && typeof payload === 'object') {
946     return Object.keys(payload).length;
947   }
948   return 0;
949 }
